items:
A work 
 permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the 
 work area is required
Wear your safety helmet, shoes ... etc

Isolate the 
 circuit breaker for the motor of this soot blower.

Isolate the 
 electrical cable feeding of the motor of the 
 soot blower.

The soot blower 
 must be isolated mechanically by closing the main valve.
Complete maintenance tool set
Cleaning fluid, Manual puller
Isolate the installation (from steam and electricity)
Remove the upper cover plates.
Remove the tipping over stud from the valves opening yoke (mk.5, docket N004).
Remove the flange of the feed tube ( mk 33 docket N004)

Slightly move the feed tube forward to clear it from the valve assembly ( take 
 care of rings mk 29 docket N004).

Remove the lower housing of the carriage (mk.10 docket N004) while holding the 
 lance in place.

Slightly lower the lance and clear it and the feed tube from the wall crossing 
 tube.
Remove the front support of square tube ( mk.69 docket N004).
Remove the rear bolt of the square tube (mk.37 docket N004).
Remove the four screws (mk.12 docket N004) from the chains fastening.

Actuate the puller to lower the assembly until the bushes ( mk.48 and 59, 
 docket N004) and their bearings.

Remove the four bolts ( mks 7,8,9, docket N004) attaching the carriage to the 
 cross pieces.

Remove the carriages upper housing (mk.10 docket N004) the Lancel carriage 
 input tube assembly can now be lowered from the blower.

After finishing disassembly of the carriage, clean all parts,
 change packing, gears chain and change 
 oil gear box.

Assemble the parts of the 
 carriage in the reverse order of the disassembly.
Check the reversible limit switch.
Cut off the steam supply.
Remove recall spring ( mk.28, docket 550 Noo1).

Remove upper pin ( mk.22, docket 550 N001) to this effect remove circlip ( 
 mk.24, docket 550 N001)
Remove the feed tubes flange ( mk.33, docket N004).
Remove the studs tightening the valve unit against the piping counter flange.

Remove the nuts attaching the valve unit to the rear plate ( mk.14, docket 550 
 N001)

Check the valve unit and change 
 any defected parts. Figure1.
Change the packing thrust flange ( mk.5, docket 550 N001)
Remove valve (mk.6,12, docket 550 N001) by the bottom.
Change the old packings.
Grind the valve and its set.
Clean and grease the packing housing.

Assemble the packing thrust flange and 
 the valve unit
A play of about 0.5 mm must remain between the valve stem and the tappet.
